## A — Exam authority, Distracted driving, seat belts and child restraints

This dossier supports first-time, never-licensed applicants preparing for the regular passenger-car written knowledge and road sign tests in Michigan. The issuing authority is the Michigan Department of State, led by the Secretary of State, and the source is the handbook What Every Driver Must Know. This section covers distracted driving and the hand-held phone ban, the general cell phone law with its emergency and hands-free exceptions, Kelsey's Law for teens with a Level One or Level Two license, seat belt requirements, and child safety seat and booster rules. The handbook pages do not state an official question count, passing score, test format or time limit for the Secretary of State knowledge test, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them and records each as an explicit unknown. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy, never an official threshold.

corpus_stability.reason: What Every Driver Must Know is a single-issuer Michigan Department of State handbook corpus with no signal of revisions more than once per year.
